title: QwQ-32B: Embracing the Power of Reinforcement Learning
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型发布报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要核查前沿推理模型的数据、反馈契约与可复现性缺口的读者
one_line: QwQ-32B discloses cold-start, outcome-based mathematics/code RL and a later general-RL stage, but withholds the training data, verifier implementations, reward calibration, and audit artifacts.
QwQ-32B 披露了 cold-start、基于结果的数学/代码 RL 及后续通用 RL 阶段，但未公开训练数据、verifier 实现、奖励校准或审计工件。
why: It cleanly separates a public model-weight release and high-level RL narrative from the unavailable data lineage, executable feedback stack, and reproducibility evidence required for reuse.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact open-weight reasoning-model report that explicitly identifies two outcome/reward-feedback stages while leaving data, reward, verifier, and audit artifacts largely undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
An open-weight reasoning-model release can identify a model and a high-level reinforcement-learning stage without supplying a reusable data recipe. For audit purposes, the missing objects matter: task provenance, prompts, generated traces, retained and rejected outputs, executable verifier details, reward calibration, splits, contamination controls, and rights can all remain unavailable.

QwQ-32B is useful for this Track 12 disclosure question because the official release makes a compact but concrete feedback claim. It names a cold start and two RL stages, including mathematics accuracy checking, code execution against predefined tests, a general reward model, and some rule-based verifiers. This Card records those disclosed interfaces and their boundaries; it does not treat public weights, benchmark outcomes, or a reasoning-output interface as a released training-data pipeline.

开放权重推理模型的发布可以说明模型与高层强化学习阶段，却未必提供可复用的数据配方。对审计而言，缺失的对象同样关键：任务来源、提示词、生成轨迹、保留与拒绝输出、可执行 verifier 的细节、奖励校准、数据划分、污染控制和权利信息都可能不可得。

QwQ-32B 对 Track 12 的数据披露问题具有参考价值，因为官方发布给出了简短但具体的反馈主张。它说明了 cold start 与两个 RL 阶段，包括数学准确率检查、针对预定义测试的代码执行、通用奖励模型和部分规则 verifier。本 Card 记录这些已披露接口及其边界；不会将公开权重、benchmark 结果或推理输出接口当作已发布的训练数据流水线。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official Qwen blog introduces QwQ-32B as a 32-billion-parameter reasoning model and states that it begins from a cold-start checkpoint. Its first RL stage scales outcome-based rewards for mathematics and coding: a mathematics accuracy verifier checks final solutions, while a code-execution server checks whether generated code passes predefined tests. A second, general-capability RL stage uses a general reward model and some rule-based verifiers.

The official model page identifies Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B as the base model and lists supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning as post-training stages. The release does not disclose the cold-start contents, SFT records, source mixture, sample counts, reward formula, general reward model, rule set, code server, test cases, or per-example lineage. The model's API separation between reasoning_content and final content is a deployment interface, not evidence of a training-record schema.

官方 Qwen 博客将 QwQ-32B 介绍为一个 320 亿参数的推理模型，并说明它从 cold-start checkpoint 开始。第一阶段 RL 针对数学和代码扩展基于结果的奖励：数学准确率 verifier 检查最终解答，代码执行服务器检查生成代码能否通过预定义测试。第二个面向通用能力的 RL 阶段使用通用奖励模型和部分规则 verifier。

官方模型页将 Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B 标为基座模型，并把监督微调和强化学习列为后训练阶段。发布材料没有披露 cold start 内容、SFT 记录、来源混合、样本量、奖励公式、通用奖励模型、规则集、代码服务器、测试用例或逐样本 lineage。模型 API 中 reasoning_content 与最终 content 的分离属于部署接口，而不是训练记录 schema 的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed scaffold is stage-level only. The Qwen blog states that outcome-based RL is first scaled for mathematics and coding from a cold-start checkpoint. Mathematics receives an accuracy-verifier signal for final solutions. Coding receives an outcome from a code-execution server that checks generated code against predefined tests. The blog then describes a later RL stage for general capabilities, trained with a general reward model and some rule-based verifiers.

The official model page additionally labels the release as having supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning post-training, and identifies Qwen2.5-32B as its base model. Neither source supplies a training dataset, prompt format, chain-of-thought record format, rollout count, sampling settings, objective formula, optimizer configuration, KL treatment, reward weights, parser, test harness, or rule inventory. The official GitHub repository provides evaluation material and usage guidance; it is not evidence that the training or verifier stack is released.

已披露的脚手架仅到阶段级别。Qwen 博客称，基于结果的 RL 先从一个 cold-start checkpoint 出发，在数学和代码任务上扩展。数学获得由最终解答准确率 verifier 提供的信号；代码获得由代码执行服务器提供的结果，该服务器检查生成代码是否通过预定义测试。博客随后说明了一个针对通用能力的后续 RL 阶段，其训练使用通用奖励模型和部分规则 verifier。

官方模型页还将该发布标为经历监督微调和强化学习后训练，并将 Qwen2.5-32B 标为基座模型。两个来源均未提供训练数据集、提示格式、思维链记录格式、rollout 数、采样设置、目标公式、优化器配置、KL 处理、奖励权重、解析器、测试 harness 或规则清单。官方 GitHub 仓库提供评测材料和使用指引；这不能证明训练或 verifier 栈已经发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary official evidence is Qwen's March 6, 2025 release blog. It directly supports the cold-start and two-stage RL narrative, the mathematics accuracy verifier, the code-execution check against predefined tests, and the use of a general reward model plus some rule-based verifiers in the second stage. The same blog identifies QwQ-32B as an open-weight release under Apache-2.0 and demonstrates a streamed reasoning_content/final-content interface.

The Qwen-owned Hugging Face model page confirms QwQ-32B, its Qwen2.5-32B base-model link, Apache-2.0 license, and SFT plus RL post-training label. The official QwenLM/QwQ repository links the release endpoints, carries Apache-2.0, and points readers to evaluation code. These are release and model artifacts, not a training-data, verifier, or audit release. Reported performance is therefore outside the evidence claimed by this Card.

首要官方证据是 Qwen 于 2025 年 3 月 6 日发布的博客。它直接支持 cold start 和两阶段 RL 叙述、数学准确率 verifier、针对预定义测试的代码执行检查，以及第二阶段采用通用奖励模型和部分规则 verifier。该博客还将 QwQ-32B 标为 Apache-2.0 下的开放权重发布，并演示了 reasoning_content 与 final content 的流式接口。

Qwen 自有的 Hugging Face 模型页确认了 QwQ-32B、其指向 Qwen2.5-32B 的基座模型链接、Apache-2.0 许可，以及 SFT 加 RL 的后训练标记。官方 QwenLM/QwQ 仓库链接这些发布端点、采用 Apache-2.0，并指向评测代码。这些是发布和模型工件，不是训练数据、verifier 或审计发布。因此，任何性能报告都不属于本 Card 所主张的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a dataset, verifier, or full recipe release. Its Track 12 value is narrower: a first-party frontier release names an outcome-feedback contract for two task families and distinguishes it from a later mixed general-reward stage. The report exposes enough to identify mathematics final-answer checking, code test execution, and the existence of a general reward-model/rule mixture.

The useful comparative contribution is the sharp boundary around that disclosure. The same release leaves the actual data objects, reward implementation, test substrate, training algorithm, and audit evidence unavailable. It therefore supports a ledger entry about what a model report says and does not say, rather than a claim that the reported pipeline can be reproduced or transferred.

这不是数据集、verifier 或完整配方发布。它对 Track 12 的价值更窄：一份第一方前沿发布为两个任务族说明了基于结果的反馈契约，并将其与后续混合的通用奖励阶段区分开来。报告披露的信息足以识别数学最终答案检查、代码测试执行，以及通用奖励模型/规则混合的存在。

其有用的比较贡献是这份披露的清晰边界。同一发布没有公开实际数据对象、奖励实现、测试底座、训练算法或审计证据。因此，它支持的是关于模型报告说了什么、没有说什么的台账条目，而不是该流水线可被复现或迁移的主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The release does not provide the cold-start, SFT, mathematics, coding, or general-RL data; source manifests; prompt templates; generated traces; acceptance and rejection logs; stage sizes; rollout counts; decoding settings; or item-level lineage. Public weights under Apache-2.0 do not establish rights to the unavailable inputs, synthetic outputs, tests, or reward-model data.

The feedback contract cannot be independently reproduced or audited. Mathematics answer extraction and accuracy checking are unnamed; the code-execution server, predefined tests, language/runtime, sandboxing, and pass criterion are unavailable; and the second-stage general reward model and rules have no disclosed implementation, calibration, coefficient, error rate, or governance record. No split, decontamination method, contamination measurement, or leakage audit is released. The official repository also cautions that deployment can exhibit endless repetitions or significant performance issues.

发布材料没有提供 cold start、SFT、数学、代码或通用 RL 数据，也没有来源清单、提示模板、生成轨迹、接受与拒绝日志、各阶段规模、rollout 数、解码设置或逐样本 lineage。Apache-2.0 下的公开权重不能证明对未公开输入、合成输出、测试或奖励模型数据拥有权利。

反馈契约无法被独立复现或审计。数学答案抽取和准确率检查未被命名；代码执行服务器、预定义测试、语言/运行时、沙箱和通过准则均未公开；第二阶段的通用奖励模型和规则也没有实现、校准、系数、错误率或治理记录。没有发布数据划分、去污染方法、污染测量或泄漏审计。官方仓库还提醒，部署时可能出现无尽重复或显著性能问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, this Card makes the model-report boundary usable in comparisons. A curator can record that stage one has programmatic outcome signals for mathematics and code, while stage two mixes a general reward model with rule-based verifiers. The same record preserves the crucial unknowns: which data and tests instantiate those signals, how they are aggregated, and whether they are robust or licensed.

It is useful when evaluating claims about RLVR, agent-related reasoning, or open-weight reproducibility. The proper comparison unit is not a benchmark score or parameter count, but the available evidence for prompts, traces, reward/verifier behavior, selection, audit, and rights. This Card is deliberately a Track 12 disclosure ledger, not a Track 8 scaling or test-time-compute entry.

对于 Track 12，本 Card 使模型报告的披露边界能够用于比较。策展者可以记录：第一阶段为数学和代码提供了程序化的结果信号，而第二阶段混合了通用奖励模型与规则 verifier。同一记录也保留关键未知项：哪些数据和测试实现了这些信号、它们如何聚合，以及它们是否稳健或具有明确许可。

它适用于评估关于 RLVR、agent-related reasoning 或开放权重可复现性的主张。恰当的比较单位不是 benchmark 分数或参数量，而是关于提示、轨迹、奖励/verifier 行为、筛选、审计和权利的可用证据。本 Card 特意是 Track 12 的披露台账，而不是 Track 8 的缩放或 test-time compute 条目。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the cold-start and two-stage RL description as a stage-level disclosure, not as a released SFT or RL dataset recipe.
  • Keep the mathematics accuracy verifier and code-execution tests separate from their undisclosed parser, test suite, runtime, thresholds, and calibration.
  • Do not infer the identity, size, data source, or policy of the second-stage general reward model from its mention in the blog.
  • The Qwen2.5 Technical Report is base-model context only; QwQ-32B has no dedicated official arXiv record or DOI in the checked sources.
  • Record the public weights, evaluation repository, and API interface as release artifacts, not as substitutes for data lineage or audit evidence.

• 将 cold start 和两阶段 RL 的说明视为阶段级披露，而不是已发布的 SFT 或 RL 数据配方。
  • 将数学准确率 verifier 和代码执行测试与其未公开的解析器、测试集、运行时、阈值和校准区分开来。
  • 不要仅凭博客提及就推断第二阶段通用奖励模型的身份、规模、数据来源或策略。
  • Qwen2.5 Technical Report 仅是基座模型背景；在已核查来源中，QwQ-32B 没有专属官方 arXiv 记录或 DOI。
  • 将公开权重、评测仓库和 API 接口记录为发布工件，而不要把它们替代为数据 lineage 或审计证据。
